meaning: The owner's worldview argument for F7 (#1007), second step: no ¬F7 cell is defeated by the approved floor. Each cell has a one-being, one-respect interpretation in which something is moved (F4); F1 is a theorem and so holds there; F3 and F6 use vocabulary absent here. So F7 stays an open alternative: defeating the cells needs floor items that jointly entail F7 (POTENCY-ANALYSIS-PARTITION, f7IffCellConstraints).
